items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know Conyers, but the Conyers family had about three or four brothers. I used to hang out with one of them, Nathan Conyers.

ctx.x: Yeah, see now that’s some inside stuff, Phil Hill. I met his brother through [Cong.] John Conyers. because the woman who was married to the cat who had the Bluebird, Edons -- was his name Eddings or Edons? Something like that. It was the guy that had the Bluebird. Clarence Eddings.
Clarence, yeah, right. I never knew Clarence’s last name, believe it or not.
